Note:
Tie break rules
Ties will be broken by the following criteria:
1. The gymnast with the highest score for either vault will prevail
2. The gymnast with the highest Execution score of either vault will prevail
3. The gymnast with the highest Difficulty score of either vault will prevail
4. If they remain tied, the gymnasts will share the same classification
